title: Generalized nonparametric regression in reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces: Consistency and rates of convergence
summary: We develop a comprehensive theory for regularized M-estimation in reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces. Under mild conditions on the loss we establish existence and measurability of the estimator, covering a wide range of convex and non-convex losses, including bounded robust losses. We further prove sharp rates of convergence with an explicit bias-variance decomposition governed by a novel complexity measure.
